pages.title: Criteria
pages.summary: What counts as a match: gates, hard exclusions, scoring, target criteria, the card threshold and flags.
pages.body:
# Criteria

What counts as a match on {{board.name}}. The scan applies this page exactly as written, in this order: gates, then hard exclusions, then the score. Set up {{today}}; filled in by the job-search-setup skill, and yours to edit at any time.

## Changing a rule

Only you set a rule. The scan never invents, widens or softens one: if a posting makes it wish for a rule that is not here, it says so in the ledger's run notes. Every rule below records the date it was set and one line of why. A rule that is replaced moves to **Retired** with its date and what replaced it, so nothing stale gets restored.

## What I'm looking for

- Titles and level: not set
- Permanent, interim or contract: not set

## Where

- Base: not set
- Places I would travel to: not set
- Remote: not set
- Relocation: not set

| not set | | | |

## Target criteria

Optional: three to six checkable things the role you want has. Each card shows how many it meets.

- not set

## Threshold

- A posting becomes a card in Found at a score of: 6

# Candidate Facts

Everything known about you beyond the CV: what the gap analysis on every card is judged against. Each fact records its source, its date, any framing rule, and whether you have confirmed it. Facts the Tool inferred stay **unconfirmed** until you confirm them; documents never rely on an unconfirmed fact without asking.

Format: `- The fact. (source: where it came from, YYYY-MM-DD · framing: how to say it · confirmed)`

# Writing Rules

How documents are written: the constraints on how the content on CV Baseline and Candidate Facts is used. "Stop using that phrase" goes here; "it was 30 people, not 25" goes on CV Baseline or Candidate Facts.

## Voice

- CV: not set
- Covering letter: not set
- Recruiter messages: not set

## Banned phrases

- not set

## Positioning

- not set

## Tailoring

- May change: not set
- May not change: not set

## File naming

- CV: not set
- Covering letter: not set

## Style guide

- not set

## Build

Read by the build script. `bullet` is the list character; `cv pages` is the page count every CV must have.

```build
bullet: -
cv pages: 2
```

## Checks

Run on every document by the build script. A line is `<rule> <documents> | <label> | <regex>`: the rule is `forbid`, `require` or `max N`; documents are `all`, or any of `cv`, `letter`, `other`. Patterns ignore case; `(?-i:...)` makes part of one case-sensitive. Setup proposes these with you; every hit is read before anything is fixed.

